steps.eval: (async()=>{const T=await import('/node_modules/three/build/three.module.js');const s=window.__scene;const g=new T.PlaneGeometry(6,6);g.rotateX(-Math.PI/2);for(let k=0;k<17;k++){const v=Math.min(255,k*16)/255;const l=v<=0.04045?v/12.92:Math.pow((v+0.055)/1.055,2.4);const c=new T.Color();c.setRGB(l,l,l);const m=new T.Mesh(g,new T.MeshBasicMaterial({color:c,fog:false,depthTest:false}));m.position.set(3000+(k-8)*6,80,0);m.frustumCulled=false;m.renderOrder=9999;s.add(m);}return s.children.length})()
